title: Serious spaces? [D]
summary: As much as I love Reddit, it can really be hit and miss for serious discourse on AI and machine learning. Depending on which sub I guess. But are there any spaces outside of Reddit where there is more conversation, more community and less trolling? To be able to have a decent con
reason: Reddit discussion post asking for community/discussion spaces outside Reddit. No named model release, no research paper or benchmark, no industry business event, no policy action, and no OSS tool/framework release; no rule covers it.
